Helper sensitivity declaration must retain actual scenario set as estimand and membership maps; cannot attach deletion metrics to original complete population.
Report original forced relative FAIL only in original historical decision; diagnostic deletions must not be published as replacement A/B/C/D.
Public JSON must exclude keyed per-deletion means and individual shot metrics, including nested helper evidence.
All 18 declared deletion results and every paired shot comparison must be retained privately, including adverse outcomes.
process_note: An initial AGENTS/CLAUDE filename-discovery command was broader than needed and returned unrelated instruction-file paths. No unrelated file contents or scientific evidence were read; subsequent reads were task-local and explicitly named.
retained_artifact_reads: Read-only named run and its bound public authorities; inspected schema, identity, support, byte hashes and receipt chain, without computing sensitivity outcomes.
